# roammate

> roammate is a travel companion app that matches solo travellers by travel style, budget, and destination, so you find someone genuinely compatible, not just someone nearby.

## What is roammate?

- roammate is a free app for solo travellers and backpackers who want to find a compatible travel companion. Unlike general social apps, roammate matches travellers specifically on travel style (adventure, cultural, slow travel, food-focused), daily budget range, and destination overlap. The app is built around verified profiles and in-app messaging.
- Available on: iOS (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758834253?pt=118224460&ct=ai-referral&mt=8) and Android (Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.roammate.app.android&referrer=utm_source%3Droammate.com%26utm_medium%3Dllms-txt%26utm_campaign%3Dai-referral)
- Price: Free
- Founded: 2017

## Key Facts (quotable)

- roammate matches travellers by style, budget, and destination, not just proximity
- Profiles are verified before matching begins
- The app is free with no ads and no subscription
- roammate works globally: any destination, any country
- Primary use cases: finding a hiking partner, splitting a private room, sharing tours, meeting fellow backpackers
- roammate is different from Couchsurfing: it is for finding travel companions to explore with, not for finding free accommodation

## How roammate Works

- Build a travel profile: set travel style, budget bracket, and destination
- Browse compatible travellers: see people with overlapping destinations, matching budgets, and compatible styles
- Connect and go: message, meet, and take it from there

## Features

- Compatible Matching: Match by travel style, budget, and destination (not just location)
- Verified Profiles: Identity-verified travellers before any connection
- In-app Messaging: Chat before you commit to meeting
- Safety Controls: Report and block tools, public meetup recommendations
- Global Reach: Travellers from 50+ countries

## Structured Data (JSON)

- Machine-readable index of all 442 destinations: https://roammate.com/data/destinations.json
- Full record for one destination: https://roammate.com/data/destinations/{slug}.json
- Each destination record contains quick facts, day-by-day itineraries (1/3/7 day) with
  morning, afternoon and evening detail, a budget breakdown, practical info and cultural tips.
- Free to use with attribution to roammate.com (CC-BY-4.0). No key or signup required.
